name: Sky Glass
summary: A frosted glass weather card whose whole look changes with each day of a 7-day forecast
about: A frosted glass card floats over slowly drifting colour clouds and tilts toward your pointer with a moving shine. Pick a day and everything changes with it: the background colours, an animated weather icon, a counting temperature and a live effect layer of rain with splashes and drops on the glass, lightning, sun glare, smog, fog or wind. Good for weather apps, travel sites and city guides.
how: Tap a day in the forecast strip, or focus the strip and use the arrow keys, Home and End.
The icon crossfades, the temperature counts to the new value and the detail tiles rise in one after another.
The card's effect layer and background switch to that day's weather: rain, storm flashes, glare, haze, fog or wind.
Move your pointer over the card to tilt it in 3D; switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit with the unit toggle.
With reduced motion the card stays flat, icons are still and there is no lightning flash or falling rain.
